input: Write a thank-you email to my professor.

output.preset:
Dear Professor [Name],

I wanted to take a moment and let you know how much your help meant to me throughout our recent coursework. Your guidance and insightful feedback were invaluable, providing me with the tools I needed to understand complex concepts and develop a deeper understanding of the material.

Your insights not only helped me to improve my own skills, but they also inspired me to work harder on other parts of the course, which led to some amazing results. Your patience and willingness to provide feedback at every opportunity was impressive, and I'm thrilled to see how much I've learned from your tutelage.

I will always be grateful for the time you spent helping me, and I know that you will continue to inspire me in future classes. You truly are a remarkable professor, and it's been a pleasure working with you.

Thank you for everything. Your hard work has made all the difference in our coursework, and I couldn't be happier about the progress we have made.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
output.personal:
Dear Professor [Name],

I hope you are having an amazing week! I just wanted to take a moment to say "thank you" for all your hard work and dedication in helping me achieve such excellent grades this semester. Your guidance and support have been instrumental in my academic success, and I wanted to take this opportunity to express my sincere appreciation.

I am grateful to have had you as my professor throughout the course of the semester. You have provided invaluable insights into various topics that have helped me make significant progress in my studies. Your approach to teaching has been incredibly engaging and interactive, which has enabled me to grasp complex concepts with ease.

Your expertise and dedication towards your subject matter have inspired me to put in even more effort and work hard to excel academically. I am grateful for the knowledge and skills that you have shared with me, and I believe that I would not be where I am today without your guidance and support.

I hope that these words express how much I appreciate all that you have done for me. Your encouragement and support have been a driving force behind my academic success this semester, and I will always be grateful for your contributions to my educational journey.

Once again, thank you for everything!

Sincerely,

[Your Name]

input: Write a internship letter for a company

output.preset:
Dear [Company Name],

I am writing to express my interest in joining your team as a writing assistant. I have been a freelance writer and copywriter for several years, having gained experience in various industries including finance, healthcare, and travel. In recent months, I have witnessed the growth of your company, and I believe that this position would be an excellent opportunity for me to apply my skills and knowledge.

As a freelance writer, I am adept at creating engaging content that resonates with diverse audiences. My writing style is clear, concise, and easy to understand, which has earned me numerous commendations from clients who have been impressed by the quality of my work. I am confident in my ability to produce high-quality content for your company, and I am excited about the opportunity to apply my skills to help you achieve your goals.

In addition to my writing experience, I hold a bachelor's degree in English literature from [University Name], where I was a recipient of various academic honors. This qualification has equipped me with an advanced understanding of language and its usage in various forms of communication, which would be beneficial for the position of writing assistant.

I am available for full-time employment immediately. As my skills are transferable to your company's needs, I am confident that this role will provide me with ample opportunity to grow and learn new things while working towards achieving professional success.

Thank you for considering my application. I am excited about the prospect of collaborating with your team, and I believe that I can contribute significantly to your organization's growth and success.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
